sentences.en: I quickly realized that my text needed an exhaustive revision.
sentences.zh: 我很快意识到我的文本需要进行彻底的修订。

sentences.en: The police undertook exhaustive searches but failed to find the body.
sentences.zh: 警方进行了详尽的搜查但未能找到尸体。

sentences.en: Not a single one of these definitions is either exhaustive or cogent.
sentences.zh: 这些定义中没有一个是全面且有说服力的。
